locales.title: Add or Change a Python API
locales.summary: Define the public contract first, then implement and verify success, error, and compatibility behavior.

locales.title: 增加或修改 Python API
locales.summary: 先定义公共契约，再实现并验证成功、错误和兼容性行为。

locales.title: Context Budgeting and Bounded Tasks for Coding Agents
locales.summary: Maximize coding agent accuracy by controlling context size, writing explicit task contracts, and enforcing automated verification loops.

locales.title: Coding Agent 上下文预算与精准任务设计
locales.summary: 通过控制上下文体积、编写明确任务契约与建立自动化验证闭环，最大化 Agent 编码准确率。

locales.title: One source of truth for agent rules
locales.summary: Stop maintaining diverging AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules files — build a checker that proves your repository has exactly one rule source, taught hands-on with your coding agent.

locales.title: Agent 规则的单一真源
locales.summary: 不再同时维护彼此打架的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 与 .cursorrules——亲手构建一个能证明仓库只有一处规则真源的检查器，由你的编码 Agent 授课。

locales.title: Measure the drift you already have
locales.summary: Run the checker against the three scenario repositories and read drift as a test failure, not a vibe.

locales.title: 量化你已经存在的漂移
locales.summary: 对三个场景仓库运行检查器，把漂移读成测试失败，而不是一种感觉。

locales.title: Decide the source of truth
locales.summary: AGENTS.md becomes the one file agents read; everything else is a pointer or a copy — decide, then write it down.

locales.title: 确定唯一真源
locales.summary: AGENTS.md 成为 Agent 唯一阅读的文件；其余都只能是指针或副本——先决定，再写下来。

locales.title: Drive a bounded change, test by test
locales.summary: Make the starter detect source, pointer, copy, and drift — one failing test group at a time.

locales.title: 按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
locales.summary: 让 starter 依次识别真源、指针、副本与漂移——一次一组失败测试。

locales.title: Verify and wire it in
locales.summary: Prove both verifier directions, run all three skins, then add the checker to your repository's review loop.

locales.title: 验证并接入流程
locales.summary: 证明验证器双向通过、跑完三个皮肤，然后把检查器接入你仓库的审查环。

locales.title: Apply this to your repository
locales.summary: One AGENTS.md, thin pointers everywhere else, and a failing check when it breaks.

locales.title: 把这套方法带回你的仓库
locales.summary: 一个 AGENTS.md，其余全是瘦指针，一旦破坏检查就失败。

locales.title: Hands-on Python with Claude Code
locales.summary: An agent-taught course that takes you from a cloned folder to a tested, verified Python report tool using Claude Code — including the task contract, the bounded change, and the objective pass/fail evidence.

locales.title: 用 Claude Code 实战 Python
locales.summary: 一门由 Agent 授课的课程：从下载课程文件夹到交付一个经过测试与验证的 Python 报表工具——包括任务契约、最小变更和客观的通过/失败证据。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure before you fix anything
locales.summary: Clone the folder, meet the starter, and make the failure objective with verify.py — the habit that separates "it runs" from "it ships".

locales.title: 第 1 课：先复现故障，再谈修复
locales.summary: 打开课程文件夹，认识 starter，用 verify.py 把"坏了"变成客观证据——这是"能跑"与"能交付"的分水岭。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract before the change
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — the single highest-leverage skill for working with coding agents.

locales.title: 第 2 课：动手之前先写任务契约
locales.summary: 把"优化一下"变成有边界、可测试的契约——这是与编码 Agent 协作杠杆最大的一项技能。

locales.title: Lesson 3: Drive a bounded change, test by test
locales.summary: Let the agent edit the starter under contract — smallest change, no new dependencies, red to green one group at a time.

locales.title: 第 3 课：按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
locales.summary: 让 Agent 在契约约束下修改 starter——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组测试从红到绿。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like an engineer, review like a skeptic
locales.summary: Run the full verification loop, review the agent's diff for scope and side effects, and record what you did — and did not — prove.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像工程师一样验证，像怀疑者一样审查
locales.summary: 跑完整验证闭环，审查 Agent 的 diff 是否越界、有无副作用，并如实记录证明了什么、没证明什么。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Apply this to your own project
locales.summary: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own: contract, isolation, rounding, atomic writes, and an honest verification record.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把这套方法带回你自己的项目
locales.summary: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上：契约、错误隔离、舍入、原子写入，以及一份诚实的验证记录。

locales.title: Hands-on with the OpenAI Codex App
locales.summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in the Codex desktop app, where an agent thread runs the loop and you supervise diffs and approvals.

locales.title: 上手 OpenAI Codex 应用
locales.summary: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 Codex 桌面应用里手把手教：由 Agent 线程跑闭环，你监督 diff 与审批。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure in a Codex thread
locales.summary: Open the folder as a Codex project, start your first thread, and make the failure objective with verify.py — inside the app, not beside it.

locales.title: 第 1 课：在 Codex 线程里复现故障
locales.summary: 把文件夹作为 Codex 项目打开，开启第一个线程，用 verify.py 让失败变得客观——在应用内完成，而不是在应用旁边。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract, let AGENTS.md carry the rules
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then make it durable so every Codex thread starts with the same rules.

locales.title: 第 2 课：写任务契约，让 AGENTS.md 承载规则
locales.summary: 把「改好一点」变成有边界、可测试的契约——再让它持久化，让每个 Codex 线程都从同一套规则开始。

locales.title: Lesson 3: The bounded change, reviewed hunk by hunk
locales.summary: Drive the starter to green through bounded turns — and use the app's diff review and approvals to keep every change yours.

locales.title: 第 3 课：有界改动，逐块审 diff
locales.summary: 通过有界的轮次把 starter 推到全绿——并用应用内的 diff 审查与审批机制守住每一处改动。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
locales.summary: Green tests are the floor, not the ceiling — run both suites, walk the scenario skins, and review the diff the way you would review a colleague's.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像评审者一样验证，别当观众
locales.summary: 测试全绿是地板不是天花板——两个套件都跑、三个皮肤都走一遍、按评审同事的标准审这份 diff。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Take the workflow to your own project
locales.summary: The tool generalizes: task contract, bounded thread, approvals, diff review — run the same loop on a script you actually own.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把工作流带回自己的项目
locales.summary: 工具会泛化：任务契约、有界线程、审批、diff 评审——在你真正拥有的脚本上跑同一套闭环。

locales.title: Hands-on with Cursor
locales.summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in Cursor, where Agent mode runs the loop and you supervise diffs and project rules.

locales.title: 上手 Cursor
locales.summary: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 Cursor 里手把手教：由 Agent 模式跑闭环，你监督 diff 与项目规则。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure inside Cursor
locales.summary: Open the folder as a Cursor project, let Agent mode read the teaching contract, and make the failure objective with verify.py — inside the editor, not beside it.

locales.title: 第 1 课：在 Cursor 里复现故障
locales.summary: 把文件夹作为 Cursor 项目打开，让 Agent 模式读教学契约，用 verify.py 让失败变得客观——在编辑器内完成，而不是在编辑器旁边。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract, let .cursor/rules carry the rules
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then make it durable so every Cursor session starts with the same rules.

locales.title: 第 2 课：写任务契约，让 .cursor/rules 承载规则
locales.summary: 把「改好一点」变成有边界、可测试的契约——再让它持久化，让每个 Cursor 会话都从同一套规则开始。

locales.title: Lesson 3: The bounded change, reviewed hunk by hunk
locales.summary: Drive the starter to green through bounded turns — and use Cursor's diff review to keep every change yours.

locales.title: 第 3 课：有界改动，逐块审 diff
locales.summary: 通过有界的轮次把 starter 推到全绿——并用 Cursor 的 diff 审查守住每一处改动。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
locales.summary: Green tests are the floor, not the ceiling — run both suites, walk the scenario skins, and review the accumulated diff the way you would review a colleague's.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像评审者一样验证，别当观众
locales.summary: 测试全绿是地板不是天花板——两个套件都跑、三个皮肤都走一遍、按评审同事的标准审这份累积 diff。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Take the workflow to your own project
locales.summary: The tool generalizes: task contract, bounded agent work, diff review — run the same loop on a script you actually own.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把工作流带回自己的项目
locales.summary: 工具会泛化：任务契约、有界 Agent 工作、diff 评审——在你真正拥有的脚本上跑同一套闭环。

locales.title: Exploratory Data Analysis with an Agent
locales.summary: A challenge course — point your agent at a messy shop export and produce a verified EDA summary (results.json) whose numbers are checked against ground truth. First non-stdlib course in the catalog; pandas is managed with uv.

locales.title: 用 Agent 做探索性数据分析
locales.summary: 挑战式课程——让你的 Agent 处理一份脏的商店导出数据，产出一份经过真值校验的 EDA 摘要（results.json）。目录中第一门非标准库课程；pandas 由 uv 管理。

locales.title: Challenge 01: What messy data looks like
locales.summary: Profile the shop export before touching pandas: exact duplicates, unparseable amounts, one bad date — count the dirt first.

locales.title: 挑战 01：脏数据长什么样
locales.summary: 动手写 pandas 之前先给商店导出数据画像：完全重复、无法解析的金额、一条坏日期——先把脏数清楚。

locales.title: Challenge 02: Define the answer first
locales.summary: Sketch results.json — keys, types, rounding — before letting the agent write eda.py.

locales.title: 挑战 02：先定答案
locales.summary: 先勾出 results.json 的键、类型与舍入规则，再让 Agent 写 eda.py。

locales.title: Challenge 03: Clean and summarize
locales.summary: Implement load_transactions, clean_transactions, summarize, write_results, main until all twelve tests pass.

locales.title: 挑战 03：清洗与统计
locales.summary: 实现 load_transactions、clean_transactions、summarize、write_results、main，十二个测试全绿。

locales.title: Challenge 04: Check against ground truth
locales.summary: The suite asserts exact numbers — 142 in, 137 clean, revenue 33347.89, top category Books; plausible-but-different fails.

locales.title: 挑战 04：核对真值
locales.summary: 套件断言精确数字——142 进 137 净、营收 33347.89、品类第一 Books；看着合理但不同即失败。

locales.title: Challenge 05: Run it on your own data
locales.summary: Port the pipeline to a real export you own and record which assumptions break.

locales.title: 挑战 05：换成你自己的数据
locales.summary: 把流水线搬到你自己一份真实导出上，记下哪些假设崩了。

locales.title: From Analysis to Report with an Agent
locales.summary: Challenge course — turn a verified EDA summary into a structured report (report.json + report.md) where every number traces back to its input. Verification checks structure and number consistency, not writing quality.

locales.title: 用 Agent 从分析到报告
locales.summary: 挑战课程——把经过验证的 EDA 摘要变成结构化报告（report.json + report.md），其中每个数字都可回溯到输入。验证检查结构与数字一致性，不评价文笔。

locales.title: Challenge 01: A report is a contract with the reader
locales.summary: List which numbers the report must carry and where each comes from in results.json.

locales.title: 挑战 01：报告是与读者的契约
locales.summary: 列出报告必须携带哪些数字，以及各自来自 results.json 的哪个字段。

locales.title: Challenge 02: Structure before prose
locales.summary: Title, exact section order Data quality → Findings → Appendix, and the metrics block — before any sentence.

locales.title: 挑战 02：先结构，后文字
locales.summary: 标题、Data quality → Findings → Appendix 的确切顺序、metrics 块——先于任何句子。

locales.title: Challenge 03: Build and render the report
locales.summary: Carry metrics through unchanged, emit # title then ## sections in order, money at two decimals.

locales.title: 挑战 03：构建并渲染报告
locales.summary: metrics 原样透传，先 # 标题再按序 ## 小节，金额两位小数。

locales.title: Challenge 04: Numbers traceable to inputs
locales.summary: Every metric in report.json equals its source field — the audit answer is a field name, not an explanation.

locales.title: 挑战 04：数字可回溯到输入
locales.summary: report.json 每个指标等于源字段——审计答案是字段名，不是解释。

locales.title: Challenge 05: What report verification cannot see
locales.summary: Structure and number consistency are checked; insight and honest conclusions are not — write the boundary sentence.

locales.title: 挑战 05：报告验证看不到的东西
locales.summary: 结构与数字一致性被查；洞察与结论诚实不在其中——写下边界句。

locales.title: Data Visualization with an Agent
locales.summary: Challenge course — turn a clean sales dataset into three spec'd charts plus a summary.json whose numbers are verified against the data. Charts must be generated from data, never hardcoded.

locales.title: 用 Agent 做数据可视化
locales.summary: 挑战课程——把干净的销售数据变成三张有规格的图和一份 summary.json，其中数字会与数据集校验。图必须由数据生成，不许硬编码。

locales.title: Challenge 01: A chart is packaged evidence
locales.summary: Say what claim each required PNG makes before writing code — the JSON summary is the auditable layer.

locales.title: 挑战 01：图是证据的包装
locales.summary: 写码前先说出每张 PNG 声明什么——JSON 摘要才是可审计层。

locales.title: Challenge 02: Spec first, chart second
locales.summary: Write which aggregation feeds each chart and what summary.json must contain before matplotlib opens.

locales.title: 挑战 02：先写规格，再画图
locales.summary: 在打开 matplotlib 之前写清每张图吃哪个聚合、summary.json 必须装什么。

locales.title: Challenge 03: Three charts and a summary
locales.summary: Implement the contract in starter/charts.py — Agg before pyplot, parsed dates, real PNG bytes.

locales.title: 挑战 03：三张图与摘要
locales.summary: 在 starter/charts.py 实现契约——Agg 先于 pyplot、日期先解析、真 PNG 字节。

locales.title: Challenge 04: Numbers match the charts
locales.summary: summary.json is checked against ground truth; a chart disagreeing with the JSON is a failed chart.

locales.title: 挑战 04：数字与图一致
locales.summary: summary.json 对照真值校验；图与 JSON 不一致就是失败的图。

locales.title: Challenge 05: Honest boundary
locales.summary: The suite checks files and numbers — not readability or honest scales; state what was not verified.

locales.title: 挑战 05：诚实边界
locales.summary: 套件查文件与数字——不查可读性与刻度诚实；写清没验证什么。

locales.title: Hands-on with DeepSeek Harness
locales.summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in DeepSeek Harness, where the agent loop is composed from plugins and every step lands in an inspectable trajectory.

locales.title: 上手 DeepSeek Harness
locales.summary: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 DeepSeek Harness 里手把手教：Agent 闭环由插件组装，每一步都落进可检查的轨迹日志。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure, read it back from the trajectory
locales.summary: Run a harness-composed agent on the course folder, make the failure objective with verify.py — then read the append-only trajectory to see exactly what the agent did.

locales.title: 第 1 课：复现故障，从轨迹里读回来
locales.summary: 让 Harness 组装的 Agent 跑在课程文件夹上，用 verify.py 让失败变得客观——再读只增轨迹，看清 Agent 到底做了什么。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract, let cordis.yml carry the setup
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then make the working rules part of the composed agent, not a forgotten prompt.

locales.title: 第 2 课：写任务契约，让 cordis.yml 承载配置
locales.summary: 把「改好一点」变成有边界、可测试的契约——再把工作规则放进组装出来的 Agent 里，而不是会被遗忘的提示词。

locales.title: Lesson 3: The bounded change, audited from the trajectory
locales.summary: Drive the starter to green through bounded steps — then prove the agent stayed in bounds by inspecting the append-only trajectory.

locales.title: 第 3 课：有界改动，用轨迹做审计
locales.summary: 通过有界的步骤把 starter 推到全绿——再检查只增轨迹，证明 Agent 没有越界。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
locales.summary: Green tests are the floor, not the ceiling — run both suites, walk the scenario skins, and review the trajectory the way you would review a colleague's work.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像评审者一样验证，别当观众
locales.summary: 测试全绿是地板不是天花板——两个套件都跑、三个皮肤都走一遍、按评审同事工作的标准审这条轨迹。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Take the workflow to your own project
locales.summary: The pattern generalizes: task contract, composed agent, bounded steps, trajectory audit — run the same loop on a script you actually own.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把工作流带回自己的项目
locales.summary: 模式会泛化：任务契约、组装 Agent、有界步骤、轨迹审计——在你真正拥有的脚本上跑同一套闭环。

locales.title: Hands-on with Kimi Code
locales.summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in Kimi Code, where built-in subagents split read-only exploration, planning, and the edits you approve.

locales.title: 上手 Kimi Code
locales.summary: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 Kimi Code 里手把手教：内置子代理把只读勘察、规划和经你批准的编辑分在三条道上。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure, survey it with the read-only lane
locales.summary: Run kimi in the course folder, let the read-only explore subagent map the code, and make the failure objective with verify.py.

locales.title: 第 1 课：复现故障，用只读道做勘察
locales.summary: 在课程文件夹里运行 kimi，让只读的 explore 子代理摸清代码，用 verify.py 让失败变得客观。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract, plan it in the planning lane
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then let the plan subagent (no write, no shell) turn it into steps before anything edits.

locales.title: 第 2 课：写任务契约，在规划道里拆步

locales.title: Lesson 3: The bounded change, one contract line at a time
locales.summary: Drive the starter to green through the coder lane in bounded steps — and review every edit before the next one lands.

locales.title: 第 3 课：有界改动，一次一条契约行
locales.summary: 通过 coder 道的有界步骤把 starter 推到全绿——下一处编辑落地前，先审完这一处。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
locales.summary: Green tests are the floor, not the ceiling — run both suites, walk the scenario skins, and review the accumulated diff the way you would review a colleague's.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像评审者一样验证，别当观众
locales.summary: 测试全绿是地板不是天花板——两个套件都跑、三个皮肤都走一遍、按评审同事的标准审这份累积 diff。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Take the workflow to your own project
locales.summary: The pattern generalizes: contract first, read-only survey, planning lane, bounded edits, written verification — run the same loop on a script you actually own.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把工作流带回自己的项目
locales.summary: 模式会泛化：契约先行、只读勘察、规划道拆步、有界编辑、书面验证——在你真正拥有的脚本上跑同一套闭环。

locales.title: Give your agent tools with MCP (Python)
locales.summary: Build a stateless Model Context Protocol tool server in pure Python — JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch, schema validation, error isolation, and the 2026-07-28 input_required round-trip — and learn where a real tool belongs.

locales.title: 用 MCP 给你的 Agent 装上工具（Python）
locales.summary: 用纯 Python 构建一个无状态的 Model Context Protocol 工具服务——JSON-RPC 2.0 分发、schema 校验、错误隔离与 2026-07-28 的 input_required 多轮交互——并理解真正的工具该放在哪里。

locales.title: What MCP actually is (2026-07-28)
locales.summary: A stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 surface for tools — no handshake, no sessions, versions in _meta.

locales.title: MCP 到底是什么（2026-07-28）
locales.summary: 一个面向工具的无状态 JSON-RPC 2.0 接口——无握手、无会话、版本放在 _meta 里。

locales.title: The JSON-RPC dispatch contract
locales.summary: Valid requests echo their id; invalid ones get -32600; unknown or removed methods get -32601.

locales.title: JSON-RPC 分发契约
locales.summary: 合法请求回显 id；非法请求得 -32600；未知或已移除的方法得 -32601。

locales.title: Validation and error isolation
locales.summary: Arguments are untrusted input: validate before execution, and never let a handler crash the transport.

locales.title: 校验与错误隔离
locales.summary: 参数是不可信输入：先校验再执行，绝不让处理函数打断传输。

locales.title: The input_required round-trip
locales.summary: A tool can ask the client a question mid-call — return the requests, finish on the retry carrying answers.

locales.title: input_required 多轮交互
locales.summary: 工具可以在调用中途向客户端提问——先返回问题，客户端带答案重试后完成。

locales.title: Expose one real tool to your agent
locales.summary: Wrap one function you actually own behind the validated, isolated boundary you just built.

locales.title: 给你的 Agent 暴露一个真实工具
locales.summary: 把你真正拥有的一个函数包进刚建好的“校验 + 隔离”边界。

locales.title: From "it runs" to "it ships": verifying AI-generated code
locales.summary: Build the release-evidence machine your AI-written project is missing — a ship check that runs the tests, parses what actually ran, refuses zero-test projects, and writes an honest delivery record.

locales.title: 从「能跑」到「能上线」：验证 AI 写的代码
locales.summary: 为你的 AI 项目补上缺失的发布证据机器——一个 ship check：运行测试、解析实际跑了什么、拒绝零测试项目，并写出诚实的交付记录。

locales.title: "It runs" is not evidence
locales.summary: Watch the starter bless a project with no tests and a project with a failing one — then want better.

locales.title: “能跑”不是证据
locales.summary: 看着 starter 给零测试的项目和有失败的项目都盖章放行——然后想要更好的东西。

locales.title: Define what a release record must prove
locales.summary: Command, exit code, parsed count and outcome, an unverified list, and a verdict that refuses zero-test projects.

locales.title: 定义发布记录必须证明什么
locales.summary: 命令、退出码、解析出的数量与结果、一份未验证清单，以及一个拒绝零测试项目的判定。

locales.title: Build the ship check, test by test
locales.summary: Parsing, verdicts, the unverified list, atomic writes, exit codes — one failing group at a time.

locales.title: 按测试逐组构建 ship check
locales.summary: 解析、判定、未验证清单、原子写入、退出码——一次一组失败测试。

locales.title: Read the record like a skeptic
locales.summary: Green, red, and no-tests mean different things — prove you can tell them apart and say what the record does not prove.

locales.title: 像怀疑者一样读记录
locales.summary: 绿、红、零测试是三件不同的事——证明你能分辨，并说清记录不能证明什么。

locales.title: Gate your next release
locales.summary: Take the ship check to a project you own and make the record part of shipping.

locales.title: 给你的下一次发布装上门禁
locales.summary: 把 ship check 带到你自己的项目，让记录成为交付的一部分。

locales.title: Hands-on with ZCode
locales.summary: The verified Python workflow — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in the ZCode desktop workspace, where Goal Mode decomposes the work and the Git state shows every change.

locales.title: 上手 ZCode
locales.summary: 经过验证的 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 ZCode 桌面工作区里手把手教：Goal 模式拆解任务，Git 状态展示每一处改动。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure inside the workspace
locales.summary: Open the folder as a ZCode workspace, give the agent its first task, and make the failure objective with verify.py — inside the app, not beside it.

locales.title: 第 1 课：在工作区里复现故障
locales.summary: 把文件夹作为 ZCode 工作区打开，给 Agent 第一个任务，用 verify.py 让失败变得客观——在应用内完成，而不是在应用旁边。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract, let Goal Mode hold the plan
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — then let Goal Mode decompose it into tasks you can watch land one by one.

locales.title: 第 2 课：写任务契约，让 Goal 模式承载计划
locales.summary: 把「改好一点」变成有边界、可测试的契约——再让 Goal 模式把它拆成你能看着逐一落地的任务。

locales.title: Lesson 3: The bounded change, watched task by task
locales.summary: Drive the starter to green through the goal's task list — and use the workspace Git state to review every change that lands.

locales.title: 第 3 课：有界改动，逐任务盯守
locales.summary: 沿着目标的任务列表把 starter 推到全绿——用工作区 Git 状态审每一处落地的改动。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
locales.summary: Green tests are the floor, not the ceiling — run both suites, walk the scenario skins, and review the accumulated Git diff the way you would review a colleague's.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像评审者一样验证，别当观众
locales.summary: 测试全绿是地板不是天花板——两个套件都跑、三个皮肤都走一遍、按评审同事的标准审这份累积 Git diff。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Take the workflow to your own project
locales.summary: The pattern generalizes: contract as goal, task list, bounded execution, Git-state review — run the same loop on a project you actually own.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把工作流带回自己的项目
locales.summary: 模式会泛化：契约变目标、任务列表、有界执行、Git 状态审查——在你真正拥有的项目上跑同一套闭环。
